paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Agra, in R. Meir's name: Chullin 134a. Rabbi said, “R. Yehudah ben Agra's words appear correct”—Niddah 53a. R. Yehudah ben Chagar, to whom R. Meir replied: Jerusalem Peah 4:7:5 (halakhah 8 in Heilprin). Jerusalem Ketubot, chapter 1, halakhah 3, has R. Yehudah ben Chagra; certainly this is he. Tosefta Kilayim, chapter 1: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel in the name of R. Yehudah ben Agra of Kefar Akko; see Yehudah of Kefar Akko above. Perhaps R. Chalafta bar Agra was his brother. R. Meir's students. He spoke in R. Yosi's name.
